title: Levenslang leren en competentieontwikkeling
contributors: P. van Eldert (Research Centre for Education and the Labour Market (ROA), Maastricht University)
descriptions: In de “ROA Werkgeversenquête Scholingsbeleid 2017” brengen we het scholingsbeleid van Nederlandse werkgevers in kaart anno 2017. In the “ROA Werkgeversenquête Scholingsbeleid 2017” (ROA Employer Training Policy Survey) we aim to gain information about the training policy of employers in the Netherlands in 2017.
